stem: On the same cohort of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, the 12-month net revenue retention is 110% and the gross revenue retention is 85%. Which statement must be true?

options.text: Cancellations on their own were worth 10% of the cohort's starting MRR
Upgrades in the cohort were worth 25% of the cohort's starting MRR
The cohort lost 15% of its businesses during the 12 months
New businesses added MRR worth 10% of the cohort's own starting MRR
